description: AI-audited cleanup policy for the outer Hermes workspace. Every operational script must be classified before Gateway restart.

required_scripts.hermes-update.sh: Authoritative update/reconcile and runtime convergence entrypoint.
required_scripts.plugins/sandbox/verify.sh: Step 8e security verifier for the Feishu sandbox plugin.
required_scripts.scripts/clean_browser_updater_cache: Operator utility for recoverable Browser updater cache cleanup.
required_scripts.scripts/cleanup_transient_artifacts.py: Policy-driven cleanup and AI audit entrypoint.
required_scripts.scripts/inject_launchd_proxy_env: Operator utility for launchd proxy environment injection.
required_scripts.scripts/nightly_greeting.py: Nightly report and Feishu greeting workflow.
required_scripts.scripts/pull_feishu_people.py: Feishu organization sync and people profile generator.
required_scripts.scripts/test_cleanup_transient_artifacts: Regression suite for the cleanup policy and mover.
required_scripts.scripts/test_nightly_greeting.py: Regression suite for the nightly workflow.
required_scripts.scripts/wiki_lint.py: LLM Wiki schema and content linter.

required_files.scripts/cleanup_policy.json: Tracked whitelist/blacklist policy consumed by the cleanup entrypoint.

removable_script_globs.test-pager*.js: Temporary Chrome DevTools pager verification script.
removable_script_globs.test-presentation*.js: Temporary browser verification script for generated presentations.
